notes: The music video opens at FULL HD now. The tab used to open on AUTO, which is the best row that carries its own sound - usually 360p - so the sharpest sizes sat in a list nobody had a reason to open. 1080p is where a viewer who has never picked a size now lands, and the size list marks that row as the default.
A video with no 1080p opens at the largest size under it, and the size list says so on the spot instead of leaving you to work out why the picture is softer than expected.

A size the phone refuses steps down one size instead of falling to the smallest - 1080p refused becomes 720p, not 360p - and the size you picked is still kept for the next video. AUTO is still in the list, and choosing it stays chosen.
